issue: Timestamp JSON depended on the session timezone, changing hashes and causing same-ID conflicts on replay.
fix: SET LOCAL TIME ZONE UTC inside export and import transactions makes row rendering canonical and restores caller settings on commit or rollback. Stored timestamp instants and schema are unchanged.

Pinned-schema timestamps retain microseconds in independent SQL text equality
